title: Create player movement
description: Add walking and jumping controls, then check that the player stays inside the level.

title: Design the main menu
description: Create a title screen with Play and Instructions buttons that are easy to find.

title: Test the first level
description: Play through the level and write down any bugs that stop a player from finishing.

title: Draw a character sprite
description: Make an original character sprite and export it with a transparent background.

title: Prepare the club playtest
description: Share the game build with club members and collect one improvement from each tester.
